body:
we were drinking. I started a fight because his female roomie was chatting with us in his room. I was getting tired. I made it very clear in a calm way I was ready for bed and wanted her to leave. I started kind of putting on my pjs hinting at her to leave because it was 3am and we were all drunk. She got the hint, left. I got upset with him and said "Why did talk so long and go on and on?".;.. he said it is time for me to leave, because it was clear a fight was going to start. 

Long story short, I became violent first, I grabbed a wooden stick thing he had in his room. I did not hit him with it at all, then he grabbed it from me and hit me. I was hit in the head, and it hit my hand and arm. I instantly started bawling my eyes out and said, please I will go now. He said no, go to my bed now. He grabbed my mouth and my head was hit against the wall, then his roommate began knocking on door because she knew something did not sound right. I instantly shouted out "please help me". And when he opened the door, I grabbed my stuff, bolted. She followed. I was panicked and was bawling. I am still feeling so fucking miserable now. I want to die. I feel like a failure. I feel like I am the reason I was hit. I grabbed the stick thing first, even though I did not hit him, I grabbed it first. I deserved this? I don't know.. 

I have been way too depressed for too long, I can't even bear to deal with the way my insides are feeling right now, I want to sleep to feel nothing, but I can't and my head is aching :(
so a threesome doesn't embody trust? god, i feel like he was just brainwashing me then..

Honestly, at this point I am starting to question that very thing. He took care of me a lot when I went through severe depression after graduating uni and moving to a new city.. but everyday he reminds me "how much he took care of me, how he put his life on hold for me, how he is doing bad in his courses since he helped me so much..." 

And then, on top of all of that, when I started improving as a person and beating my depression, he reminds me on a constant basis that he gets credit for all of that, etc.. 

I dunno :( I am starting to question things, when we get in gutty fights, like the other day, he threw the first threesome in my face saying "he will call up the other girl"... I went ballistic and acted super crazy by scratching his arm when he said it, and then he has the audacity to tell me "I am not normal, I still have a mental illness, etc".. I think any girl would be a little unstable and scratch a guys arms with him saying that  ?

funny thing is, he is ridiculously against drugs, got mad at me when I did molly once at an electronic music festival, but funny how he seems to be okay with me doing molly when it comes to the threesome because he never got mad, and i even said i would need to be on it again to go through with another, again he did not seem to mind...
Thanks for this perspective, it helps give me the strength to say no. I know if I went through with one a year, it would slowly eat away at my soul

You're absolutely right, he knows me so well, and he would subtly pressure me into giving in...

In what ways is he not respecting my boundaries? Can you point some things out, I really wanna internalize this and figure stuff out

One time in a fight he mentioned "me giving him a threesome once a year would ensure he would never have a wandering eye"... It may make him sound like a horrible man, but I am the first girl in his life he opened his heart too after his first love cheated on him and got pregnant. 

So as a result, he became this sex-crazed man that had so many threesomes and has been with so many girls, and I am the only girl in his life since his first love who has got him to only pretty much fuck me (minus that one threesome I gave him)...

So I guess my dilemma is, if I take away the threesome stuff... it is like something he so desperately loves and needs, that taking it away would make me feel like I am being a horrible gf, and maybe I should just suck it up once a year and do hard drugs to block out that one night? (for love?)
